zh: 高亮手写数字资料链接
启用喵鱼二手显卡折扣
体贴表达与已知生日提醒
加入用语解释与斗图建议
完成提示跟随音乐重音
开放概率小题题桌，练习等可能结果。
en: Opens Probability questions. Practise equally likely outcomes on its question desk.

zh: 开放新闻回顾题桌，题目来自你实际读完的新闻。
en: Opens News review using articles you have actually finished reading.

zh: 在贴吧帖子里高亮已有的手写数字资料链接，方便找到它。
en: Highlights the existing handwritten-digit data link in forum posts so it is easier to find.

zh: 在喵鱼启用现有二手显卡折扣，购买前可查看实际价格。
en: Enables the existing used-card discount on Miaoyu. Check the displayed price before buying.

zh: 加入体贴表达提示。晴雯生日提醒只在她已于聊天中明确说出日期后出现。
en: Adds a considerate expression cue. Qingwen's birthday reminder appears only after she has stated the date in your saved chat.

zh: 在 YY 表情选择器里加入现有网络用语解释和斗图建议。
en: Adds the existing slang explanations and sticker suggestions to the YY sticker picker.

zh: 训练完成提示可跟随正在播放的音乐重音。没有可辨认的重音时，使用普通完成提示；训练结果立即记入。
en: A completed training round can pulse with an audible accent in the music that is playing. Without a clear accent, it uses the normal completion cue. Training results are saved immediately.

zh: 条件已完成，可以去科技页看看。是否购买由你决定。
en: The condition is complete. Take a look in Tech whenever you like; buying is optional.

zh: 本轮完成 · 随音乐重音
本轮完成 · 无清晰重音，使用普通提示
en: Round complete · no clear accent; normal cue
